newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industry, transport unions call Dec 13 strike.
newsitem.headline: Italy industry, transport unions call Dec 13 strike.

text.p: Italian unions said on Wednesday they had called a national four-hour strike in the industry and transport sectors for December 13.

Leaders of Italy's three main union confederations had previously announced their plans to stage a stoppage in support of metalworkers, who are protesting against a failure to renew their contracts since June.
Metalworkers have already called an eight-hour strike for this Friday, their second such action in two months.
Union leaders said they planned to hold a national demonstration on jobs on January 18.
